title: VertexED content and AI reliability improvements
head: e28f24ff1c051eaa91b5443a79fe392987d0c688
changes: Corrected eight AI and study guides against implemented workflows, inputs, saving behaviour and assessment limitations; substantially rewrote five.
Rejected provider outputs marked incomplete, filtered or refused before generating study artifacts. Chat can display a refusal without treating it as a sourced answer.
Matched citation validation to the exact source excerpts admitted to each prompt budget; moved chat reference text out of system instructions.
Preserved complete validated quiz questions, answer options, explanations and flashcard backs instead of truncating them after validation.
Separated concept-map source notes from diagram syntax; added source previews, readable labels, keyboard scrolling, contained mobile layout and theme-aware text.
Improved article reading surfaces and dark-mode heading contrast.
Preserved the existing /projects sitemap entry by adding it to the generator after detecting prebuild removal.

build.configuration: Synthetic Supabase URL and public key for browser fixtures

visualReview.automatedCoverage: Eight guide routes at every width, action links, keyboard focus, sign-in return path, theme controls and heading contrast. Notebook source preview, focus restoration, arrow-key scrolling, failed-regeneration preservation and reload.
visualReview.inspection: Representative guide and concept-map screenshots inspected at all three widths. Correction passes fixed subtitle artifacts, reading-surface contrast, diagram sizing, mobile overflow and notebook dark-mode text.

correctionHistory.finding: Initial application run had one stale accessibility-region count after adding the generated concept-map region.
correctionHistory.resolution: Updated the expected count; full application rerun passed.

correctionHistory.finding: Larger concept-map labels widened the mobile grid instead of scrolling internally.
correctionHistory.resolution: Constrained the studio grid item. Keyboard scrolling and absence of page overflow passed.

correctionHistory.finding: Visual review found inherited dark-mode notebook text remained dark and manual CSS theme changes produced inconsistent captures.
correctionHistory.resolution: Added explicit notebook foreground colour; tests use real theme controls and check relationship text colour.

openGates: Live AI quality, latency, failure rate and educational accuracy were not measured. No configured server AI credentials were available in this checkout.

The imported MYP inventory contains 245 files: 192 unreviewed and 53 flagged for review, with zero approved. Source, licensing, factual and curriculum review remain unresolved; statuses were preserved.
Citation validation checks source-ID membership, not factual entailment or source reliability. Prompt instructions cannot guarantee absence of model mistakes.
This work does not establish production deployment, live authentication, live database policies or independent educational validation.
